## Item 1 — the reader × filter matrix

File `ab,cd\nef,gh\n`, `string.toupper` on `STREAM_FILTER_READ`:

| reader | php 8.5.6 | elephc before | after |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fread` | `AB,CD\n` | `AB,CD\n` ✅ | ✅ |
| `fgetc` | `A`,`B` | ✅ | ✅ |
| `stream_get_contents` | `AB,CD\n…` | ✅ | ✅ |
| `fgets` | `AB,CD\n` | **`ab,cd\n` RAW** | ✅ |
| `stream_get_line` | `AB,CD` | **`ab,cd` RAW** | ✅ |
| `fgetcsv` | `["AB","CD"]` | **RAW** | ✅ |
| `fscanf("%s")` | `["AB,CD"]` | **RAW** | ✅ |
| `fpassthru` | `AB,CD\nEF,GH\n` | **RAW** | ✅ |
| `feof` after `fgets` drains | `true` | **`false`** | ✅ |
| all of the above, userspace-wrapper backend | filtered | **RAW** | ✅ |

`ftell` agreed only by accident — `string.toupper` is 1:1. With `convert.base64-encode` (8 bytes → 12), php reports **12** (bytes handed back); elephc reported the descriptor's **4**. Both `fgets` and `stream_get_line` now ride `STREAM_FILTERED_POS_OFFSET`, so both report 12, and the `$length` bound applies to filtered bytes (`fgets($h,3)` → `ON`, ftell 2).

**Root cause:** only `__rt_fread` ran the chain. The other three helpers issued their own `read()` on the descriptor — so the chain was never *flushed* either, and `__rt_stream_eof_get` waits on that flush before reporting `feof()` true. Each reader also picked its byte source by asking the **backend** first, so a filter on a wrapper-backed stream had no branch that could see it. Fix: ask the chain **before** the backend in all three; when present the source becomes `__rt_fread` on the opaque handle (`__rt_fread_raw` resolves descriptor-vs-wrapper underneath). Only the *source* moves — newline scan, delimiter scan, bound and window growth stay one copy. `stream_get_line` additionally has to **claim** its reservation on the filtered path, since `__rt_fread` allocates from the same concat scratch.

## Item 2 — NAN → string warning

php: `Warning: unexpected NAN value was coerced to string in <file> on line <n>`, on **stdout**, once per **coercion** (`f() . f()` → 2, loop → 1/pass), `@`-suppressible. php 8.2.31 measured silent ⇒ new in 8.5. Nine forms warn (`echo`, `(string)`, `strval`, `implode`, concat, `sprintf('%s')`, interpolation, `print_r`, string builtins); `INF`/`-INF`/`0.0`/`-0.0`/finite and `var_dump`/`json_encode`/`number_format`/`sprintf('%f')` stay silent. elephc emitted correct bytes, zero warnings.

All nine forms converge on `__rt_ftoa`; the four silent renderers each own a different formatter. One entry probe there covers the surface — that placement *is* what keeps the four silent. New clobber-free `__rt_warn_nan_coerced_string` modelled on the existing `__rt_warn_nan_coerced_bool`, through `__rt_diag_warning` (`@` honoured), gated `>= 80500`, with both in-band quiet-NaN sentinels filtered so a missed float read still reports only `Undefined array key`.
